_doc: One row per SMG area, spelled once. scripts/render.py writes these into skills/map/SKILL.md (where things live), skills/map/reference.md (subsystems, lanes, areas without a recipe) and skills/review-pr/SKILL.md (file-to-checklist mapping); scripts/lanes.py maps a diff to lanes, checklists and recipes for gate.sh. `paths` are SMG path prefixes (a trailing slash means a directory). `checklists` name files under skills/review-pr/checklists/. `lanes` name the CI jobs below. check_anchors.py verifies every path and lane name against the SMG checkout.

lanes.pre-commit: pr-test-rust.yml: codespell, whitespace, yaml/toml, ruff, rustfmt, clippy hooks
lanes.python-lint: pr-test-rust.yml: ruff + mypy over e2e_test/, bindings/python/, scripts/
lanes.build-wheel: pr-test-rust.yml: maturin wheel, Go FFI library, generated client types, WASM fixtures
lanes.python-unit-tests: pr-test-rust.yml: bindings/python tests at 80% coverage, scripts/tests
lanes.rust-lint: pr-test-rust.yml: clippy -D warnings in four feature legs (all-features, self-hosted, anthropic-only, default-build)
lanes.rust-tests: pr-test-rust.yml: cargo test, sharded; Postgres and WASM fixtures; vision goldens regenerate
lanes.benchmarks: pr-test-rust.yml: genai-bench against mock workers, all policies
lanes.e2e-1gpu-chat: pr-test-rust.yml: chat suite per engine on one GPU
lanes.e2e-1gpu-chat-symphony: pr-test-rust.yml: chat suite under the default parser
lanes.e2e-1gpu-chat-zmq: pr-test-rust.yml: single-worker chat replayed over ipc://
lanes.go-bindings-e2e: pr-test-rust.yml: Go SDK against a gateway
lanes.e2e-discovery: e2e-discovery.yml: kind, consul, file and slurm discovery
lanes.e2e-mcp-mock: e2e-mcp-mock.yml: MCP against a mock server

areas.name: Config and CLI
areas.where: flag groups in main.rs (`CliArgs` flattens `RoutingArgs`, `WorkerArgs`, `DiscoveryArgs`, `ServingArgs`, `ModelArgs`, `IntegrationArgs`), value parsers in cli/, RouterConfig types, builder and validation

areas.name: Protocol types
areas.where: shared OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini API types for every consumer; vendor profiles under src/profile/

areas.name: App wiring and server
areas.where: AppContext construction, the axum router and middleware stacks, TLS, connection limits, auth posture, health probes

areas.name: Routing policies
areas.where: load-balancing policies, factory and registry; cache-aware selection pipeline in cost/

areas.name: Routers and dispatch
areas.where: the gateway front (gateway.rs), factory, HTTP proxy router, the Mode-parameterized gRPC pipeline, external-router mounting, shared dispatch in common/

areas.name: Non-routing endpoints
areas.where: tokenize/detokenize, parse, conversations, stored responses, model inventory

areas.name: Admission
areas.where: priority scheduler (classes, queues, slots, preemption) and the legacy concurrency cap

areas.name: Per-tenant rate limiting
areas.where: token and request budgets per tenant, reserve/settle in the gRPC pipeline

areas.name: Tenancy and serving auth
areas.where: tenant identity, per-request resolution, serving-path API keys

areas.name: Control-plane auth
areas.where: JWT/OIDC and API keys for the control plane, roles, audit

areas.name: Service discovery
areas.where: kubernetes, consul, file and slurm providers behind one reconciler

areas.name: Workers and registration
areas.where: worker registry, health, load, circuit breaking, KV event monitor; registration DAG steps and job queue

areas.name: Workflow engine
areas.where: the wfaas step engine the registration DAG runs on

areas.name: Symphony (default parser)
areas.where: format tables, registry and checkpoint groups, call-syntax assemblers, grammars, API adapters

areas.name: Legacy parsers
areas.where: per-model tool and reasoning parsers for --parser legacy; the HF response-template port

areas.name: Tokenizer
areas.where: HF and tiktoken backends, chat templates and native renderers, stop/EOS decoding, encode cache; gateway-side registration per worker

areas.name: KV-cache index
areas.where: radix trees for routing-side prefix matching, the event-driven chain index, the generic prefix core

areas.name: gRPC engine clients
areas.where: per-engine gRPC clients and protos; the GrpcClient enum

areas.name: ZMQ direct backend
areas.where: same-host ipc:// wire, the per-engine adapter, the gateway seam

areas.name: Engine servicers
areas.where: the Rust and Python servicers that serve each engine's gRPC proto on the engine node

areas.name: Third-party provider routers
areas.where: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and xAI routers and the shared glue (SSE, retry, MCP utils, realtime)

areas.name: MCP
areas.where: MCP client: inventory, approval policy, transports

areas.name: Storage
areas.where: conversation and response storage backends, migrations, hooks, bounds

areas.name: Multimodal
areas.where: vision and audio processors, model specs, media fetching; gateway planning and the capability matrix

areas.name: WASM plugins
areas.where: the WASM host, the WIT world, middleware guests

areas.name: Mesh HA
areas.where: SWIM gossip, CRDT namespaces, gateway wiring

areas.name: Observability
areas.where: metrics, OTel tracing, structured logging, runtime self-metrics

areas.name: RL control plane
areas.where: worker discovery, engine-route passthrough and fan-out; inert unless --enable-rl

areas.name: Bindings
areas.where: Python PyO3 Router and launcher, servicer bindings, Go SDK

areas.name: Generated clients
areas.where: the OpenAPI spec and Python/Java clients generated from protocol types; the Rust client

areas.name: E2E harness and CI
areas.where: e2e suites, fixtures and launchers, CI tooling and workflows

areas.name: Mock workers and test harness
areas.where: mock HTTP/gRPC/ZMQ workers and the in-process app builders every wire feature needs an arm in

areas.name: Helm chart
areas.where: the chart; its arguments are pinned to RouterArgs by a bindings test
